fvtt-player-spotlight.resetData.title: Reset Spotlight Data
fvtt-player-spotlight.resetData.descript: Clears all spotlight data stored so far. This is a non-reversible action.
fvtt-player-spotlight.sortMode.title: Spotlight Sorting Mode
fvtt-player-spotlight.sortMode.descripti: How to sort players as spotlight are given and removed.
fvtt-player-spotlight.sessionAutoStart.d: If enabled, the module will automatically start a new spotlight session when the window is open and the current date differs from the date of the last registered session.
fvtt-player-spotlight.playerFilter.title: Player filter
fvtt-player-spotlight.playerFilter.descr: Whether to show only active/connected players on the tracker.
fvtt-player-spotlight.nameMode.title: Name Display
fvtt-player-spotlight.nameMode.descripti: How should each player be represented in the tracker?
